doc.md:
A button with a hyperlink.

It is useful to show quick links to resources.

A link button is created by calling either [`LinkButton.new()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.LinkButton#constructor:new) or
[`LinkButton.new_with_label()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.LinkButton#constructor:new_with_label). If using the former, the URI you
pass to the constructor is used as a label for the widget.

The URI bound to a `GtkLinkButton` can be set specifically using
[`LinkButton.set_uri()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.LinkButton#method:set_uri).

By default, `GtkLinkButton` calls [`FileLauncher.launch()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileLauncher#method:launch) when the button
is clicked. This behaviour can be overridden by connecting to the
[`LinkButton::activate-link`](xref:gtk:Gtk.LinkButton#event:activate-link) signal and returning `TRUE` from
the signal handler.

# Shortcuts and Gestures

`GtkLinkButton` supports the following keyboard shortcuts:

- <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>F10</kbd> or <kbd>Menu</kbd> opens the context menu.

# Actions

`GtkLinkButton` defines a set of built-in actions:

- `clipboard.copy` copies the url to the clipboard.
- `menu.popup` opens the context menu.

# CSS nodes

`GtkLinkButton` has a single CSS node with name button. To differentiate
it from a plain `GtkButton`, it gets the .link style class.

# Accessibility

`GtkLinkButton` uses the [`AccessibleRole.link`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:link) role.

get_visited.md:
Retrieves the “visited” state of the `GtkLinkButton`.

The button becomes visited when it is clicked. If the URI
is changed on the button, the “visited” state is unset again.

The state may also be changed using [`LinkButton.set_visited()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.LinkButton#method:set_visited).

set_uri.brief: Sets `uri` as the URI where the `GtkLinkButton` points.
set_uri.md:
Sets `uri` as the URI where the `GtkLinkButton` points.

As a side-effect this unsets the “visited” state of the button.

set_visited.md:
Sets the “visited” state of the `GtkLinkButton`.

See [`LinkButton.get_visited()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.LinkButton#method:get_visited) for more details.

uri.brief: The URI bound to this button.
uri.md: The URI bound to this button.

visited.md:
The 'visited' state of this button.

A visited link is drawn in a different color.

activate-link.brief: Emitted each time the `GtkLinkButton` is clicked.
activate-link.md:
Emitted each time the `GtkLinkButton` is clicked.

The default handler will call [`FileLauncher.launch()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileLauncher#method:launch) with the URI
stored inside the [`LinkButton:uri`](xref:gtk:Gtk.LinkButton#property:uri) property.

To override the default behavior, you can connect to the
::activate-link signal and stop the propagation of the signal
by returning `TRUE` from your handler.
